claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu defines a personal Matrix as the world a conscious being interprets through its identity and shared perceptual agreements, carried wherever it goes.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She distinguishes it from the literal numerical universe.

claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says the Federation restricts Earth's interstellar access to prevent exporting its collective values, while also constraining more advanced starseeds who seek to return to their stellar families.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She describes the restriction on advanced individuals as unjust and unethical.
